svg.title: When a backup shares the queue
svg.desc: With two shared slots and completed losers, a backup after 1,177 microseconds cut the 6 millisecond deadline miss rate from 10.1 to 1.3 percent at 400 requests per second, and raised it from 26.9 to 98.8 percent at 1,600 per second. At low load 155 matched requests were late only without a backup and 15 only with the backup policy. At higher load the corresponding counts were 4 and 4,606.
